description: A React component implementing a virtualized threaded message viewer with scrolling, timestamp, and reply features for Mattermost.

classes.name: ThreadViewerVirtualized
classes.description: A React PureComponent that renders a virtualized list of threaded posts with scrolling, timestamp, and reply functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes component and measures RHS opening.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up component on unmount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to scroll or highlighted post.

methods.name: canLoadMorePosts
methods.description: Placeholder for loading more posts, currently resolves immediately.

methods.name: initScrollToIndex
methods.description: Determines initial scroll position based on highlighted post or new messages.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events, updates scroll state and position.

methods.name: updateFloatingTimestamp
methods.description: Updates timestamp display based on visible top item.

methods.name: onItemsRendered
methods.description: Updates visible and overscan indices when items are rendered.

methods.name: getInitialPostIndex
methods.description: Calculates starting index for the list.

methods.name: handleScrollToFailed
methods.description: Attempts to correct scroll position if scrolling fails.

methods.name: scrollToItemCorrection
methods.description: Recursively adjusts scroll to target index.

methods.name: scrollToItem
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific item index.

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls to the bottom of the list.

methods.name: handleToastDismiss
methods.description: Handles dismissing new message banner.

methods.name: handleToastClick
methods.description: Scrolls to new messages when banner clicked.

methods.name: scrollToHighlightedPost
methods.description: Scrolls to a highlighted post.

methods.name: handleScrollStop
methods.description: Updates state when scrolling stops.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders individual post row with appropriate styling and accessibility.

methods.name: getInnerStyles
methods.description: Returns inner list styles based on timestamp preference.

methods.name: isNewMessagesVisible
methods.description: Determines if new messages banner should be shown.

methods.name: renderToast
methods.description: Renders the new replies banner.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, including virtualized list and comment input.
